title: Deal Action Engine
description: Diagnose stalled deals by reading the actual notes and email history, then draft a targeted re-engagement email that addresses the real blocker, not a generic check-in.

children.text: Diagnose stuck deals and draft re-engagement emails that address the real blocker.

If the user specifies a deal, pull that deal from the CRM or notes they provide.
If the request is "all stalled" or unspecified, focus on deals with no contact in the past 7 or more days.

For each deal, gather:
- Current stage and status
- Last email or message content
- Notes and activity log
- Any price history or offer details

Read the actual notes and email history. Do not assume. Common blockers:

| Signal | Likely Blocker |
|--------|---------------|
| No reply after offer | Hasn't seen it, not interested, or price objection |
| Replied then went quiet | Specific objection not addressed |
| Said "later" | Timing issue, needs a reactivation nudge |
| Multiple price changes, no close | Decision pending at floor price |
| Active thread, no commitment | Undecided, needs urgency or social proof |

Write an email that:
- References the specific thing blocking this deal, not a generic "just checking in"
- Is short: 3 to 5 sentences maximum
- Has one clear ask or call to action
- Matches the tone of the prior thread

```
# Deal Action: [Deal or Contact Name]

## Diagnosis
[What is actually blocking this deal based on notes and email history]

## Recommended Email Draft

Subject: [subject line]

[email body]

---

## Next Step If No Reply
[What to do if this email gets no response]
```
